q: What does an EU wire or fastener maker need from a Visakhapatnam wire rod supplier for CBAM?
title: Vizag wire rod: what EU buyers need
short: Wire rod under CN 7213 is a CBAM good. The importer needs specific direct emissions per tonne (indirect emissions are not counted for steel), the production period and the installation. If the buyer draws wire or makes fasteners outside the EU, its own figure includes the rod as a precursor, so pass the rod figure down.
audience: Wire drawers, fastener and spring makers buying Indian wire rod, and their EU importers

ul: CN code and tonnes per shipment.
Specific direct emissions per tonne; indirect emissions are not counted for iron and steel.
Whether actual data or default values were used.

p: A fastener maker in India exporting to the EU adds its own drawing, heat treatment and plating emissions to the precursor figure from the rod. Without the rod figure it falls back to default values.
Mill test certificates without carbon data. Ask for the CBAM figure in the same document set as the test certificate.

senseible: Senseible reads coal, coke, gas, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure in a CBAM or buyer response can be traced back to the documents behind it.
